svg.title: SYNSPEQ pipeline in detail
svg.desc: Molecules are ingested, reduced to distinct molecules, planned with AiZynthFinder and saved as routes. Each molecule ends in one outcome. Four measures, findability, precedent support, residual steps and scaffold diversity, are computed with their denominators and written to a report.

Every number comes with its counts and denominator. The run manifest records the stock, the planner settings and the checksum of every resource. A missing resource is
reported as not assessed, unavailable, bound or blocked, never as 0%. Results are comparable only under the same stock and planner settings.
synspeq run does all of it, from the SDF to the report
